questions.question: Find the surface areas of prisms 24 × 1 × 1, 6 × 4 × 1 and 4 × 3 × 2 cm. What does this show?
questions.expected_answer: 98, 68 and 52 cm². All have volume 24 cm³; the more compact the shape, the smaller the surface area.

questions.question: Describe what happens to the surface area and volume of a cube when its side doubles from 1 cm to 2 cm.
questions.expected_answer: Surface area goes from 6 to 24 cm² (× 4); volume goes from 1 to 8 cm³ (× 8). Volume grows faster than surface area.

questions.question: Which box holding 1 000 cm³ uses the least cardboard: 10 × 10 × 10, 20 × 10 × 5 or 40 × 5 × 5? Why might a company still choose another shape?
questions.expected_answer: The cube (600 cm² versus 700 and 850). Other shapes may fit shelves, show advertising better or be easier to post.
